To the best of my knowledge, there are no current planning applications affecting 45 Philpot Street.

Previous planning permissions, listed building consents, non-material amendments and discharge of condition applications exist for the wider development site within which 45 Philpot Street is located, including PA/17/02844, PA/17/02846 and PA/17/02845 and associated amendments and condition discharges.

Some of the wider consents included demolition works to other properties within the overall development, however no demolition has taken place at 45 Philpot Street itself beyond works authorised under the relevant consents, and no demolition is proposed as part of this application.
description: Proposed internal refurbishment to a Grade II listed dwelling within a conservation area. Works include the removal and alteration of non original internal partitions, minor internal reconfiguration, skimming using appropriate traditional materials, and upgrades to services. Repairs and sympathetic upgrades to windows (including secondary glazing) are proposed, alongside new floor finishes, replacement of non original doors, stair replacement, kitchen and bathroom renovations, and like for like timber repairs. All works are internal and intended to preserve the character and significance of the listed building.
